entries.title: One question gets one answer
entries.body: When you send a question and then a quick correction, one answer from your first mate now covers both. When your first mate passes your question to a crewmate and the crewmate answers on its card, that answer counts too. Before, your first mate could answer the same question a second time.
entries.noPicture: This stops a repeated answer in a card's thread; no view or control looks different.
